heavy_formulae.block-goose-cli: Large Rust, CMake, and protobuf application build; keep it demand-driven.
heavy_formulae.emacs: Large application build; install on demand if it is actually needed.
heavy_formulae.erlang: Large language runtime build; install on demand if it is actually needed.
heavy_formulae.grpc: Large C++ build; keep it out of the bounded speculative queue.
heavy_formulae.mysql: Large database server build; keep it out of the bounded speculative queue.
heavy_formulae.ollama: Large Go, CMake, and MLX build; keep it demand-driven.
heavy_formulae.opencv: Large optional computer-vision build; keep it demand-driven.
heavy_formulae.openvino: Large C++ inference-runtime build; keep it out of speculative prewarming.
heavy_formulae.ortp: Nonessential Linphone RTP library whose upstream GitLab source is unreachable from the runner; do not maintain or prewarm it.
heavy_formulae.php: Large language runtime build; install on demand if it is actually needed.
heavy_formulae.qemu: Large emulator build; keep it demand-driven.
heavy_formulae.semgrep: Large OCaml and Python application build; keep it demand-driven.

node.reason: Node.js provides official macOS installers and version-manager based installation; do not spend the Homebrew Intel source-build budget on this runtime.

mise.reason: Upstream recommends mise.run on macOS; its official binary is more optimized than the Homebrew build.

rustup.reason: Bootstrap tool with an official macOS installer; do not spend the Homebrew source-build budget on it.
